description: This file contains a PyTorch FX graph transformation pass called 'reinplace' that modifies computational graphs to convert out-of-place tensor operations into in-place variants, with complex logic to ensure correctness and handle view/scatter operations.

classes.name: _ViewType
classes.description: Enum class representing different view types in tensor operations.

classes.name: _FunctionalizationMetadataProp
classes.description: FX Interpreter subclass that tracks metadata related to functionalization, such as fake tensor results and view relationships.

methods.name: _is_view_op
methods.description: Checks if a given operator overload is a view operation.

methods.name: _get_view_type
methods.description: Determines the view type of a given operator overload.

methods.name: _schemas_match
methods.description: Checks if two schemas (functional and inplace) match in name and argument types.

methods.name: _maybe_get_inplace_op
methods.description: Returns the inplace variant of an operator overload if available and compatible.

methods.name: _get_all_later_node_usages
methods.description: Finds all nodes in the graph that use any of the given tensor aliases after a specific node index.

methods.name: _get_view_inverse_node_usages
methods.description: Identifies view/scatter nodes that are safe to remove when re-inplacing.

methods.name: reinplace
methods.description: Main function that modifies an FX GraphModule to convert out-of-place tensor ops to in-place, handling complex cases with views and scatter ops.
